# Medisca

> > Medisca is an Australian pharmaceutical supplier specializing in compounding ingredients, APIs, excipients, and pharmacy equipment for healthcare professionals.

Medisca provides a comprehensive catalog of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), cream bases, excipients, and specialty pharmacy supplies for compounding and pharmaceutical applications. The company serves healthcare professionals with USP/EP-grade materials and innovative delivery systems.

## Key Topics

- Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API)
- USP/EP Standards
- Pharmaceutical Compounding
- Cream Bases
- Excipients
- Bulk Powders
- Propylene Glycol
- Topical Dispensers
- Emulsion Systems
- Pharmacy Supplies
- Cold Storage
- Liposomal Delivery
- Compounding Equipment
- Healthcare Products
- Bulk Chemicals

## Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)

- [Levofloxacin, USP (Hemihydrate)](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/levofloxacin-usp-hemihydrate): Levofloxacin USP hemihydrate active pharmaceutical ingredient for compounding.
- [Alprostadil USP (Prostaglandin E1)](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/alprostadil-usp-prostaglandin-e1): Alprostadil USP prostaglandin E1 active pharmaceutical ingredient for compounding.
- [Omeprazole USP/EP (Powder)](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/omeprazole-usp-ep-powder): Omeprazole USP/EP powder active pharmaceutical ingredient bulk chemical supplier.
- [Finasteride, USP](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/finasteride-usp): Finasteride USP active pharmaceutical ingredient for compounding bulk supplies.

## Cream Bases & Topical Formulations

- [PenDerm™ Cream Base](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/penderm-cream-base): PenDerm™ cream base oil-in-water emulsion for compounding topical formulations.
- [Lipo Cream Base](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/lipo-cream-base): Lipo cream base liposomal delivery system for controlled pharmaceutical formulations.
- [AlpaWash®](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/alpawash): AlpaWash® water-washable PEG ointment base for compounded medications.

## Excipients & Pharmaceutical Additives

- [Lanolin USP (Anhydrous)](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/lanolin-usp-anhydrous): Lanolin USP anhydrous excipient pharmaceutical ingredient bulk chemical supplier.
- [STEVIA 90% (Powder)](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/stevia-90-powder): Stevia 90% powder excipient sweetener additive for pharmaceutical compounding.
- [FD and C Red No. 3, Erythrosine, Powder](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/fd-and-c-red-no-3-erythrosine-powder): FD&C Red No. 3 erythrosine powder color additive for pharmaceutical formulations.

## Dispensing Equipment & Supplies

- [MD® Pump](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/md-pump): MD® Pump topical dispenser product with airless pump and metered dosing specifications.
- [ChemoPlus Chemo Drug Transport Bag](https://www.medisca.com.au/products/chemoplus-chemo-drug-transport-bag-covidien-white-4-mil-6-x-9): ChemoPlus chemotherapy drug transport bag protective equipment and safety supplies.
